features: All-in-One server: video stream transfer and view plus record storage and playback, software preinstalled
CPU: Intel Xeon E3-1220V5 4-core; OS: Linux; Memory: 8GB DDR4 ECC
Max. Number of Channel Access: 2048 CH (extensible to 10000CH via the transfer server)
Max. Number of Device Access: 500 devices (extensible to 10000CH after it is authorized)
Max. Number of Channel Access of Third-party protocol: 16 (extensible to 10000CH after it is authorized)
Performance: up to 700Mbps incoming, 700Mbps recording and 96Mbps playback; up to 700Mbps incoming, 700Mbps recording and 96Mbps live view
Max. Number of Transfer Server Access: 32; Max. Number of Storage Server Access: 32
Max. Channel Number of Simultaneous Preview: 100 (for one client/user); Simultaneous Playback: 16 (for one client/user)
Max. User Access: 64 users (extensible to 1024 users after it is authorized)
Hardware RAID via 12Gbps SAS Expander, 12Gbps RAID card
Integrated I210-AT dual gigabit network cards, load balancing and failover; independent IPMI (ASPEED AST2400 BMC) with iKVM
TPM interface; TPM module installation supported
TV wall management: splicing, PIP, roaming and triggering video on TV wall
Interfaces: 1x IPMI, 1x RS232; USB: 4 rear, 2 front
2 built-in 2.5-inch HDD slots in addition to the 24 hot-pluggable bays
notes: The feature list names the CPU as Intel Xeon E3-1220V5 (4-core); the specification table gives Intel Core Processor E3.
ONVIF support is stated in the feature list, not the specification table.
Remote connections value is the stated maximum of online users previewing simultaneously.
The 2.5-inch HDD slots are stated in the feature list only.
